title: Orientation
description: auto follows the page's shape: a wide page draws time left→right, a tall page draws time running upward (the mania side strip).

title: Alignment
description: Mirrors the layout. Vertical: the side the graph's baseline and time axis sit on (put it towards the stage). Horizontal: the side of the title and the clock.

title: Skills
description: combined = one silhouette of the summed skill strains. per-skill = the same silhouette split into stacked bands in shades of the map colour: osu! aim and speed, taiko colour, rhythm and stamina. Catch (movement) and mania (strains) have a single skill.

title: Show time
description: The elapsed / total clock (the set's one map clock: first to last object, real time, so now-playing and the ticker show the same) and, in the vertical form, the time axis.

title: Show kiai and breaks
description: Kiai as a band in the map colour under the graph's baseline, across the whole map (the section you are in brighter), breaks as gaps in the graph; the fill itself only ever means played time. Read from the map's .osu file, so every section shows from the start; where the server does not serve the file, they are learned as the map clock passes them and each map remembers the sections already seen.

title: Show in song select
description: Full-map strain preview following the preview clock (osu! shows no strain graph). The page stays where it is placed, so turn this off if that spot covers song-select content. Results and other screens show nothing.

title: Motion
description: full = the graph grows in on a map change, kiai and break labels ease in and out, the kiai band of the section you are in brightens and dims. reduced = the same (this overlay has no pulses or ambience). off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Corner marks
description: The 18-LAB registration marks on the box's top-left and bottom-right corners. neutral = warm white. amber = both in 18-LAB amber. tl = amber, top-left only. none = no marks.

title: Map colour
description: Colour the map's identity (progress, star, strain fill) from the map's background. Off = neutral. Your own highlights stay 18-LAB amber either way.
